messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick heads-up — CitrusHealth wants a 4-week POC starting next Mon. Needs: Hosted API keys for devs, a Dedicated pool for inference, and VPC peering to their AWS account. Budget target: ~$2k/week + $10k trial credits for month 1. They also need SAML/SCIM for ~5 engineers. Can we stand this up today? cc @Priya
Priya (Sales Eng): Do we know expected steady QPS and model family? also which region (they prefer us-east-1). Can we do smaller instance (A10G) or do they want H100 perf?
Evan (Infra): Region ok. We can provision a small Dedicated pool (1 x A10G) w/ autoscale -> burst policy. For VPC peering we'll need their VPC ID, CIDR, and a contact to accept the peering. Private (on-prem) not requested, correct?
Sam (Sales): Correct — hosted keys + Dedicated pool (not full private). Model: they want gpt-like open model (Llama2-13B style), preprompting + long contexts. QPS ~10 req/s peak, avg 2 req/s.
Priya (Sales Eng): Good. For that QPS an A10G pool looks fine w/ batching. I'll draft the config and ephemeral-key workflow. We should create a billing project and enforce a weekly spendcap.
Dana (Finops): For billing: we can create a billing project (project id: citrus-poc-2026) and attach trial credits $10,000. Need to decide: hard spend cap (blocks requests at threshold) vs soft alerts. Which does the customer want? Also we need PO/SOW to enable Dedicated committed capacity in many accounts.
Sam (Sales): Customer prefers hard spend cap to avoid surprise. They'll sign a short SOW. Can finance provision provisional access pending SOW?
Dana (Finops): We can apply credits and a soft cap immediately. Hard cap for Dedicated pools requires approval from revenue ops (contractual). I'll flag for expedited review — should be doable within 24-48h if SOW is on file.
billing-bot: billing-bot created project citrus-poc-2026, applied 10000 USD promo credit, default daily token quota 200k. (id:citrus-poc-2026)
Priya (Sales Eng): For developer access we can generate ephemeral keys scoped to project with TTL 8h. Example (internal):
```
# generate ephemeral key
redwood auth create-ephemeral --project citrus-poc-2026 --scopes generate,embeddings --ttl 8h
```
Evan (Infra): VPC peering steps for customer (quick): 1) give us their VPC ID + region 2) we create peering request from our VPC 3) they accept and add route. I'll send a tidy checklist and required security CIDR. Also: for the Dedicated pool we need to know if they require private networking (no public egress) — that affects setup time.
Sam (Sales): They want egress restricted to their VPC endpoints only (no public internet).
Evan (Infra): Ok that bumps lead time ~1 business day because we need to enable private egress and exchange peer routes. Still within timeline. For Dedicated sizing: A10G estimate cost ~ $1,600/week (w/ autoscale and batching) to meet 10 qps with low latency. H100 would be ~ $4k/week. Those are rough.
Priya (Sales Eng): I'll send a short one-pager with pros/cons and recommended config. Also will include sample prompt sets for quality checks and an eval hook so we can monitor regressions.
Dana (Finops): Notes: apply promo credits to citrus-poc-2026, create spendcap rule: weekly hard cap $2k -> requires legal/RevOps ok for Dedicated. If they sign SOW we can escalate to hard enforcement. Billing contact?
Sam (Sales): Customer billing contact is leah@citrushealth.com, legal is matt@citrushealth.com. I'll attach their SOW draft shortly.
security-bot: security-bot: security questionnaire link shared — https://redwood.internal/sq/req-2345 — they requested encryption at rest + KMS integration and audit logs.
Evan (Infra): KMS integration for Dedicated is supported; we'll need their KMS ARN for key wrapping. Audit logs are available via console.
Priya (Sales Eng): Action items: 1) Evan to create Dedicated pool in us-east-1 + VPC peering checklist, 2) Dana to apply promo credits + create provisional soft cap, 3) Sam to collect VPC details & SOW, 4) Priya to send config + dev onboarding docs.
Evan (Infra): I'll start provisioning and post updates here. ETA: pool + provisional networking config by EOD.
Dana (Finops): I'll apply credits now and create the soft weekly cap rule. Will ping RevOps for hard cap approval when SOW arrives.
Sam (Sales): Awesome — thanks all. Looping in the customer now with next steps and contacts. :thumbsup:
